navigation.summary: Jumped from Alpha Centauri to Sol

entries.text: Mission Assessment: The mission was aborted due to the lack of an ice harvester module, which was essential for mining at Alpha Centauri Frost Ring. Execution was methodical, but the oversight in equipment preparation led to mission failure. Future plans: Acquire an ice harvester module before venturing to ice fields, and verify resource requirements for all planned destinations.
